image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an African crocodile's head and upper jaw. The mouth is slightly open, revealing interlocking conical teeth. The skin texture is highly detailed, showing rough, bony scutes on the dorsal side and smoother scales near the jawline. The eye is visible with a vertical slit pupil. The background is blurred, focusing entirely on the reptile's head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure appears broad and robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image shows an open mouth with clearly defined, sharp, conical teeth. While the prompt mentions 'when mouth is closed', the visual evidence of interlocking teeth in an open state confirms the anatomical correctness of the dentition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is positioned high on the skull (dorsal). The pupil is clearly a vertical slit. The nictitating membrane is not clearly deployed but the eye structure is anatomically correct for a crocodilian.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tip of the snout is cut off by the left edge of the frame; nostrils are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the neck and head shows heavy armor plating (scutes), consistent with an elongated, armored body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture on top of the head and neck shows distinct, raised, bony ridges and scutes arranged in a pattern consistent with crocodilian anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is greyish-brown with a very rough, realistic texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lower jaw area shows smaller, smoother scales compared to the dorsal scutes, appearing lighter in color (pale grey/white).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Tail is not visible in this close-up crop.
